description:
Stop overthinking.

Confidence isn’t destroyed by action. It’s destroyed by imagining everything that could go wrong.

The longer you think, the louder fear gets.

Move first. Figure it out as you go.

Action creates confidence. Thinking creates doubt.
transcript: stop thinking. Thinking is what destroys our confidence. When you can't shut your brain off, when you're thinking about things in the past that you tried and failed, that tags your confidence and you're not going to move forward. When you think about things that could go wrong in the future and wow, what if we go on this path and then this and then this, that tags your confidence and you're not going to go forward.
